summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 skill-input is historical compatibility only and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 roles: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; distinct sourceSelectionHash binds roles/paths/modules/scope/resources and sourceContentHash binds selected bytes; adapter owns transport/pages/continuations/coverage/truncation and complete bounded-lossy summaries are not truncated; ready receipts are immutable generations at skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; validated non-authorizing current pointer advances atomically; consumers use pointer only, never mtime/suffix/scans; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derives from changed-set plus canonical path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current, lifecycle/authorization/terminal refs, unexpired attempts; committed deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate consumers to v2 before 8-18 creates current receipt; legacy skill-input-current* remains immutable historical evidence pending approved retention; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current resolution.
